key_concepts: Matter can change physical form due to heat and cold
Sublimation is the change from solid directly to gas without becoming liquid
Deposition is the change from gas directly to solid without becoming liquid
Sublimation is endothermic and feels cold compared to its surroundings
Deposition is exothermic and feels warm compared to its surroundings
Dry ice (solid carbon dioxide) is an example of sublimation
Moth balls or naphthalene balls are examples of sublimation
Snow or frost forming from water vapor is an example of deposition
Frost or ice forming on freezer sides is an example of deposition
